title: ADAPTS IDIQ
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEFENSE INFORMATION SYSTEMS AGENCY (DISA) > DEFENSE INFORMATION SYSTEMS AGENCY
description: The Defense Information Systems Agency (DISA), on behalf of the Portfolio Acquisition Executive for Command, Control, Communications, & Enterprise (PAE C3E) and the DISA SD2 Business Systems Portfolio Program Management Office, is seeking sources for the administration and management of the new  All-Domain Adaptive Platforms and Technologies Support (ADAPTS) Indefinite-Delivery/Indefinite-Quantity (ID/IQ) Single Award  contract.  The ADAPTS ID/IQ contract will provide support for DISA’s Services Platforms and analytical and business intelligence capabilities.  ADAPTS Task Orders will support sustained operations, continuous software integration, platform-as-a-service (PaaS) engineering, and unified operational visibility across the DISA Connect customer access portal, ServiceNow, Salesforce, Workday, and Palantir platforms.
